questions.q: How long does it take to train an AI model with my photos?
questions.a: With the new training model, training time is instant. Upload photos and you can already generate your photos.

questions.q: How long does it take to generate profile photos?
questions.a: Photos are ready in 1 to 2 minutes. Previously you need to train the model with your selfies.

questions.q: What type of photos should I upload to create AI profile photos?
questions.a: We recommend uploading photos with high variety, a mix of close-up selfies and full-body photos in different places, angles, clothes and expressions. Don't upload photos with low variety, group photos, other people, sunglasses, hats, photos where your face is cut off or not visible.

questions.q: How much will the photos look like me?
questions.a: The similarity of the photos to you depends on the quality and variety of the photos you upload. The better and more varied your photos are, the more accurate the AI can be in understanding and representing your unique features. We continue to improve our models every day.

questions.q: Is my information secure? Do my photos and models remain private?
questions.a: Yes! The models you create and the photos you upload and take remain private. Your personal data, images and AI models are stored securely, and our system is designed to protect your information from unauthorized access.

questions.q: Who can use my AI profile photos?
questions.a: No one. Your photos will be yours only. After 30 days they will be deleted from our servers.
Yes, we offer a full refund guarantee if you are not satisfied with the results.

faq.q: Do credits expire?
faq.a: No, credits do not expire. However, the AI model you trained expires after 30 days. You must use your credits within that time.

faq.q: What style of photos will I receive?
faq.a: Once your AI model is trained, you can select different styles from the Create tab. Each time you generate a photo in a selected style, you'll receive 4 different variants in that style. This allows you to experiment with various looks and choose your favorites.

faq.q: How long does it take to generate photos?
faq.a: The process happens in two steps: First, we train your AI model, which takes 15-30 minutes. After that, you can generate photos at any time, and each generation takes only 1-2 minutes to create 4 variants.

faq.q: Do you offer refunds?
faq.a: Yes, we offer a 100% refund guarantee if you are not satisfied with the quality of your photos. You can request a full refund within the first 7 days after your purchase.

faq.q: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a: We process all transactions using Stripe. You can pay using credit card, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay and more.

faq.q: How do I ensure the quality of my photos?
faq.a: Before training a model, we recommend reading our guide. This way you'll ensure that the generated photos are of the best possible quality.

faq.q: Who can use my photos and what about privacy?
faq.a: Your photos are exclusively yours. We prioritize your privacy and automatically delete all generated photos from our database after 30 days. The photos you generate are for your personal use and will not be shared or accessible to anyone else.

faq.q: What if the generated photos don't look like me?
faq.a: If you follow our instructions for selecting training images, you should get around 80% usable photos that look like you. We continuously update our models to improve accuracy. If you have doubts before starting, don't hesitate to contact us for guidance.

faq.q: Will the AI learn my unique characteristics?
faq.a: Yes, our AI is excellent at understanding and replicating what makes you unique. You can also adjust specific characteristics when generating images, such as whether you wear glasses or other distinctive features.

faq.q: Where can I use these photos?
faq.a: The photos are versatile and can be used anywhere you need a professional image of yourself. They're perfect for professional profile photos (LinkedIn, company websites), social media (Instagram, Facebook, Twitter) or personal branding. You can choose different dimensions like square format for profile photos or portrait mode for Instagram stories and other vertical designs.

blogPost1.title: How AI Professional Photos Can Transform Your Personal Brand

blogPost1.power3: Reflect your professionalism and attention to detail
blogPost1.power4: Help you build a consistent brand image across platforms
blogPost1.traditionalDesc: Traditional professional photography comes with several challenges:
blogPost1.traditional1: High costs: Professional photo sessions can cost hundreds or even thousands of euros
blogPost1.traditional2: Time-consuming: Scheduling, travel, and the actual session take significant time
blogPost1.traditional3: Limited variety: You typically get a small selection of photos from one session

blogPost1.benefitsDesc: AI professional photos offer numerous advantages:

blogPost2.title: 5 Reasons Why AI Professional Photos Are Better Than Traditional Photography
blogPost2.intro: The photography industry is experiencing a revolution. AI-powered professional photos are changing how people approach personal branding and professional imagery. Here are five compelling reasons why AI professional photos are superior to traditional photography.
blogPost2.reason1Desc: Traditional professional photography sessions can cost anywhere from €200 to €1,500 or more. With AI professional photos, you get 40-100 high-quality images for a fraction of that cost. You're essentially paying 5x less while getting significantly more variety and options.
blogPost2.reason2Desc: Traditional photography requires scheduling appointments, traveling to studios, and waiting weeks for edited photos. AI professional photos are generated in minutes. You can upload your selfies, choose your styles, and have professional photos ready to use the same day—all from the comfort of your home.
blogPost2.reason3Desc: A single traditional photo session might give you 10-20 final images. With AI professional photos, you can generate 40-100 different images in various styles, outfits, and backgrounds. This variety allows you to:
blogPost2.variety3: Test different styles to see what works best
blogPost2.variety4: Have options for different occasions and purposes
blogPost2.reason4Desc: AI professional photos ensure consistent quality across all your images. Every photo is generated using the same advanced AI technology, ensuring uniform lighting, professional composition, and high resolution. With traditional photography, quality can vary based on the photographer's skill, equipment, and conditions.
blogPost2.reason5Desc: AI professional photos give you complete control and privacy. You upload your own photos, choose your styles, and generate images without needing to interact with photographers or visit studios. Your images are processed securely, and you maintain full control over your professional image.
blogPost2.futureDesc: AI professional photos represent the future of personal branding. They combine the quality of traditional photography with the convenience, affordability, and variety that modern professionals need. As AI technology continues to improve, the gap between AI and traditional photography will only continue to narrow.

blogPost3.title: How to Choose the Perfect Professional Photo Style for Your Brand
blogPost3.intro: Your professional photo is often the first impression people have of you online. Choosing the right style is crucial for building your personal brand. With over 100+ styles available, here's how to select the perfect professional photo style for your brand.
blogPost3.understandIndustryDesc: Different industries have different expectations for professional photos:
blogPost3.industry1: Corporate/Business: Professional business attire, formal backgrounds, conservative styling
blogPost3.industry2: Creative Industries: More casual, artistic backgrounds, creative expression
blogPost3.industry3: Tech/Startups: Modern, approachable, slightly casual professional look
blogPost3.industry4: Healthcare: Professional, trustworthy, clean and polished
blogPost3.industry5: Education: Friendly, approachable, professional but warm
blogPost3.considerPlatformDesc: Different platforms may require different styles:
blogPost3.platform3: Company Website: Match your company's brand aesthetic
blogPost3.matchBrandDesc: Your professional photo should reflect your personal brand values:
blogPost3.brand1: If you're innovative: Choose modern, cutting-edge styles
blogPost3.brand2: If you're traditional: Opt for classic, timeless professional looks
blogPost3.brand3: If you're approachable: Select warm, friendly styles with natural lighting
blogPost3.brand4: If you're authoritative: Choose strong, confident poses and formal attire
blogPost3.backgroundSelectionDesc: The background of your professional photo sets the tone:
blogPost3.background4: City backgrounds: Modern, dynamic, urban professional
blogPost3.tipsForSuccessDesc: Here are some additional tips for choosing the perfect professional photo style:
blogPost3.tip1: Start with a few different styles and see which resonates most
blogPost3.tip2: Consider your target audience and what they expect
blogPost3.tip3: Ensure consistency across all your professional platforms
blogPost3.tip4: Update your photos regularly to keep your brand fresh
blogPost3.tip5: Test different styles to see what gets the best response
blogPost3.conclusionDesc: Choosing the perfect professional photo style is about understanding your industry, platform, and personal brand. With AI professional photos, you can easily experiment with different styles until you find the perfect match. Remember, your professional photo is an investment in your personal brand—choose wisely.
